segments.title: the incompatible qualities

spans.eng: the quality of being water and the quality of not being water
if something exists and lacks one of these qualities, it must then possess the other

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment by Codex, independent English-first proposal. The three incompatible substances are recast as pus and blood versus either of the other two; gsum po is omitted rather than falsely equated with 'two'. chu yin min is retained as a complete phrase because the single Tibetan chu supplies both English water occurrences. phan tshun spangs 'gal is matched at phrase depth to its explicit mutual-exclusion definition; dngos 'gal owns 'directly incompatible'. Although HGM also lists 'directly incompatible' under the former compound, the sole occurrence is not claimed twice. The long definition is supported by HGM's exact gloss and the passage's syntactic qualification. Omitted la sogs pa / gnyis po de have distributed enumeration/reference contributions; no uncertain correspondence is nulled.
